# Jessie Sunday

> Jessie Sunday is a San Francisco community and experience strategist: a fractional embedded strategist and community architect. She helps companies whose culture is their edge turn that culture into something people can feel, through retreats, launches, brand activations, and community programs, from strategy through production. San Francisco rooted, working across the Bay Area, the West Coast, and beyond.

Key facts:

- Ten years of bringing people together: Club Med stages, guiding Birthright Israel trips, building one culture for 500 LivingSocial Adventures ambassadors across 15 markets, six years at Jack Morton Worldwide across 10+ Fortune 500 accounts, then queer community galas, takeovers, a sold-out retreat, and her own productions.
- $30M+ in experiential budgets directed, 1M+ participants across programs built and led, 3,000+ guests at events personally produced, 20+ brands partnered with.
- Experience with Google, Meta, Intel, GM, Cruise, Docker, T-Mobile, Another Planet Entertainment, and LivingSocial.
- Two ways to work together: a fractional and retainer partnership (Jessie joins a team as a fractional Head of Community and Experience), or a project-based engagement for one retreat, launch, or gathering.
- Services: community and culture strategy; experience and concept design; assembling and leading the production crew (producers, artists, technical teams, local collaborators).
- Works with values-led brands and founders, experiential and event agencies, experience-led companies, and lifestyle, hospitality, and community brands.

## Case studies

- [Headprint Studio](https://jessiesunday.com/work/headprint-studio/): Community events for a queer-owned San Francisco salon. 600+ tickets, 100+ new clients, one space grown to three.
- [The Barb Shop](https://jessiesunday.com/work/the-barb-shop/): Pop-up haircut experiences in Dolores Park, at Pride, and at Outside Lands for an online brand. Hundreds of cuts and an ongoing content library.
- [LivingSocial Adventures](https://jessiesunday.com/work/livingsocial-adventures/): One culture across 15 markets. 500 ambassadors, an NPS above 80, and programs reaching a million participants.
- [Jack Morton Worldwide](https://jessiesunday.com/work/jack-morton/): Six years as the client’s go-to person across 10+ Fortune 500 accounts, with 20+ new brand relationships.
- [Jewish Federation LA](https://jessiesunday.com/work/jewish-federation-la/): Community programming that engaged 2,000+ young adults and grew engagement 80% year over year.
- [The Release Series](https://jessiesunday.com/work/the-release-series/): A 400-person takeover and a sold-out wellness retreat for 60 women in quiet third-space properties.
- [All selected work](https://jessiesunday.com/work/)
